title: Tributes pour in as NFL world mourns, remembers football giant and HOFer Mike Ditka

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Tributes pour in as NFL world mourns, remembers football giant and HOFer Mike Ditka
sources.description: A Hall of Fame coach who guided the iconic 1985 Bears to a Super Bowl XX title, Ditka won 106 games in Chicago, second in franchise history
